title: 潮騒の灯台と、名前を忘れた獣
author: ポム・ド・テール

prediction.question: エルナは影と会話できるか？

en.title: The Lighthouse of the Sea's Roar and the Beast Who Forgot Its Name
en.premise: Every tide brings a mysterious "forgotten thing" from the sea to this strange town. A girl, searching for the shadow of her missing brother, wanders into an old lighthouse at the tip of a cape. There she meets a blue‑eyed cat with no name. Guided by the cat, she encounters the terrifying yet beautiful truth hidden in the lighthouse’s "border between light and shadow."

zh.title: 潮声灯塔与忘记名字的兽
zh.premise: 潮汐每次涨潮，海里会有“被遗忘的东西”漂流到这个神秘的城镇。少女为了寻找失踪兄弟的影子，迷失在岬角的古老灯塔。她在那里遇到了一只没有名字、眼睛蓝色的猫。跟随猫的引导，少女触碰到灯塔所照亮的“光与影的边界”中潜藏的恐怖而美丽的真相。
